उदृ उद्-ऋ, cl. 3. P. -इयर्ति (Ved. aor. A.
-आर्त), -अर्तुम्, -अरितुम्, or -रीतुम्, to start up,
rise; to move up, raise, excite: Caus. -अर्पयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to rise.

उद्दॄ उद्-दॄ, cl. 9. P. -दृणाति, -दरितुम् or
-रीतुम्, to tear out.

उदृच् उद्-ऋच्, क्, f. (fr. rt. रिच् with उद्), Ved.
that which reaches beyond (the present time) or
what follows, future time; remainder, conclusion, end,
aim; concluding part or hymn (?).

उदृष् उद्-ऋष्, cl. 6. P., Ved. -ऋषति,
-अर्षितुम्, to split, pierce through.

उद्दृश् उद्-दृश्, cl. 1. P. -पश्यति, -द्रष्टुम्,
to see above (in the sky), to look upwards; to look
into the future, expect; to become aware of; to doubt:
Caus. -दर्शयति, -यितुम्, to make visible, cause to
appear.
